seo.title: ODDnetwork — stay involved throughout the year
seo.description: A developing year-round network for organisations that want to stay involved with ODD, learn across sectors and help move the same things forward.

title: Stay involved beyond a single event.
intro: Some organisations want to stay involved after the event or project is over. ODDnetwork is the working model for that: a year-round group of organisations that want to learn from each other, stay close to ODD's activity and help build stronger connections between creative fields, business and society. The exact model is still being shaped with the first organisations involved.

whatItIs.headline: A network you take part in, not a membership card.
whatItIs.body: ODDnetwork is meant for organisations that want continuity: regular contact, shared conversations and useful ways to take part across the year. It should grow from what the organisations in it actually want to do together, rather than from a fixed benefits list invented in advance.

whoItsFor.label: Organisations wanting an ongoing creative connection
whoItsFor.description: Companies and institutions that want an ongoing way to meet people outside their usual field and keep learning from the creative world.

whoItsFor.label: Partners already working with ODD
whoItsFor.description: Partners and collaborators who want to keep the relationship active beyond one event or project.

whoItsFor.label: Organisations exploring the creative economy
whoItsFor.description: Teams that believe creative work should have a stronger place in business and society — and want to contribute, not just observe.

includes.title: Ongoing contact
includes.body: Regular contact from the ODD team — a simple, ongoing relationship with the ODD team and the other organisations involved.

includes.title: Participation across the year
includes.body: Invitations to ODD events and gatherings, plus small conversations around the questions the network actually cares about.

includes.title: A closer relationship
includes.body: Introductions across the network as relevant opportunities come up — not networking for its own sake, but when there's a real reason for people to meet.
